idea-plugin.name: Dynamic Query
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for dynamic queries, where [ ... ] marks an optional predicate that the runtime keeps or drops depending on whether its parameters are bound:

  • @DynamicJpqlQuery — JPQL
  • @DynamicNativeQuery — Native SQL

The plugin injects JPAQL or SQL into the annotation value while leaving the [ ] markers out of the injected fragment, so IntelliJ's own parsers see a plain query. You keep syntax highlighting, entity/table and field/column resolution, completion and parameter inspections — and no longer need @Language("JPAQL") or @Language("SQL").

@DynamicJpqlQuery("""
    SELECT u FROM UserEntity u
    WHERE 1 = 1
    [ AND u.name = :name ]
    [ AND u.age = :age ]
    """)
